changes: Add direct YouTube video playback from supported URLs or 11-character video IDs in actions and Assist tools.
Align Assist Cast-player filtering with the action's Google Cast integration criterion.
Split documentation into an English default README and a Korean README, preserving the HACS installation information from main.
Add the HACS repository validation GitHub Action for pushes, pull requests, scheduled runs, and manual dispatch.
Make applicable HACS manifest settings explicit and remove the unused ZIP filename setting.
Declare Home Assistant 2024.6.0 as the minimum version for the LLM API provider feature.
Declare the integration as single-config-entry in manifest metadata and sort manifest keys per Home Assistant requirements.
Add selectable official YouTube app-to-Cast and SmartTube-to-Cast fallback modes, with Cast-only playback available.
Use both Android TV Remote and Google Cast targets for app-link fallback and validate each integration owner.
Preserve legacy entries on Cast-only playback while defaulting new entries to SmartTube-to-Cast fallback.
Update Assist tool, configuration translations, and playback documentation.
Add Netflix title and episode lookup playback through Android TV Remote deep links.
Document Netflix title and episode playback actions.
Register Netflix playback as a separate Assist LLM provider from YouTube.
Allow the Netflix Assist tool to operate independently of the YouTube API key and playback mode.
Document independent YouTube and Netflix Assist provider selection.
Replace Netflix title lookup's broad Brave/DDG page scan with DuckDuckGo POST search and structured result-title link parsing modeled on assist_web_search.
Retry DuckDuckGo challenge pages through curl_cffi with a Chrome TLS fingerprint, matching assist_web_search auto-backend behavior.
Report unresolved challenge responses separately from empty or unparseable search results and add regression coverage for redirects, unrelated links, and backend retry.
Port the Assist Web Search DDG request, challenge detection, curl_cffi fallback, bounded responses, and structured result parsing into YouTube Content Search for standalone use.
Use DuckDuckGo's moderate SafeSearch setting and preserve localized Netflix title links.
Add the standalone httpx dependency and tests for DDG parsing, challenge fallback, and blocked responses.
Inspect Netflix top-level title metadata to distinguish movies from series.
Launch movies directly through the Netflix watch URL when no season or episode is specified while retaining title-page behavior for series.
Fall back to the title page if Netflix title-type metadata cannot be read and cover both branches with tests.
Remove Netflix title and episode playback functionality from this integration.
Remove playlist save/delete actions, persistent storage, and related documentation.
